# ChainScreen Content Overview

ChainScreen is a compliance research hub for EU crypto asset service providers (CASPs), focused on practical, evidence-based content for small compliance teams, founders, and regulated crypto businesses.

ChainScreen publishes content only. The former public API, wallet checker, lead forms, and developer API documentation were retired on 2026-05-12.

## Company

- Legal entity: DailyMind LTD
- Registration: HE 439959
- Jurisdiction: Limassol, Cyprus
- Website: https://chainscreen.io
- About: https://chainscreen.io/about
- Contact: info@chainscreen.io

## Regulatory Coverage

ChainScreen articles cover EU and selected international crypto-compliance developments that matter to CASPs, including:

- MiCA authorization status, CASP licensing requirements, and ESMA register checks
- EBA restrictive-measures guidance for CASPs and PSPs
- EU Travel Rule implementation under Regulation (EU) 2023/1113
- AMLA, AMLR, DORA, and related operational compliance timelines
- CySEC inspection expectations, Article 63 transitional issues, and sanctions-screening evidence
- EU sanctions packages, sanctions-list coverage, and false-positive handling
- U.S. stablecoin AML/sanctions developments where they affect global crypto compliance planning

## Content Sections

### Regulations

https://chainscreen.io/regulations/

Regulatory explainers and checklists covering MiCA, EBA restrictive-measures guidance, Travel Rule implementation, ESMA CASP register data, EU sanctions-list expectations, regulatory roadmaps, and stablecoin compliance developments.

### Operations

https://chainscreen.io/operations/

Operational guides for compliance officers and founders covering inspection files, bank-review evidence, sanctions-screening implementation, compliance budgeting, CySEC checklists, and enforcement lessons.

### Tools

https://chainscreen.io/tools/

Neutral research on sanctions-screening tools, vendor comparison criteria, Chainalysis alternatives, oracle limitations, screening versus monitoring, and crypto sanctions false positives.

### Technical

https://chainscreen.io/technical/

Technical explainers covering blockchain analytics depth, address clustering, source-of-funds tracing, mixing detection, and GDPR/data-residency issues for compliance tooling.

## Reader Notes

- ChainScreen content is informational and does not replace legal advice.
- Articles cite official or primary sources where possible.
- Register counts, enforcement status, and rulemaking deadlines can change; compliance teams should confirm live data with the relevant authority before making operational decisions.
